metadata.description: Claude Code skills for the Ano CLI and desktop app — now split into 9 focused domain skills for faster trigger-scoped loading

plugins.name: ano-skills
plugins.description: Skills for interacting with Ano — 9 self-contained skills covering core/messages/channels/coworkers/notifications/tables/automations/realtime/payloads. Each loads only when its triggers match, so a 'send a message' invocation no longer pulls the full CLI surface into context.
